name: Mont-Orford National Park
policyReason: Leashed dogs are allowed on several trails year-round, some campground loops and two beaches.
summary: Leashed dogs are allowed on several trails year-round, some campground loops and two beaches.

excerpts.quote: Notez que les chiens sont admis dans certains sentiers, du 1er mai au 30 novembre.
Les chiens sont admis dans le parc.

dogRules.text: Summer trails: Ruisseau-David, Ruisseau-des-Chênes, Boucle du Mont-Chauve, Boucle-des-Trois-Étangs, Étang-Fer-de-Lance, La Cavalière.
Winter trails (Dec 1 to Apr 30): Ruisseau-David and Boucle du Mont-Chauve.
Lac-Stukely (Frêne, Cèdre) and Lac-Fraser (Colvert, Branchu, Bernache) campground loops.
Dogs allowed in rented or personal boats at the Stukely and Fraser rental centres.
No dogs at Étang aux Cerises or the Pic aux Corbeaux climbing site.
